penalties.details: NHAI, vide its letter No. NHAI/CO/13013/547/22-23/Dinengpasoh FP/E-276473/843 dated September 10, 2026, has approved forfeiture of part Performance Security amounting to Rs. 1,60,00,000/- (Rupees One Crore Sixty Lakh only) furnished by the Company under the Contract Agreement dated June 10, 2022 (Work Order No. NHAI/13013/547/CO/22-23/CB/Dinengpasoh FP/E-42345/17 dated June 10, 2022) for engagement as the user fee collection agency at Diengpasoh Fee Plaza (Km 24.700) on the Shillong Bypass connecting NH-40 and NH-44, in the State of Meghalaya. The forfeiture has been imposed under Clause 18(a) of the Contract Agreement, which provides for forfeiture of part Performance Security equal to 15 days' agreed remittance (Rs. 1,60,00,000/-) upon completion of three incidents of levy of penalty for excess charging of User Fee.
penalties.impact: Pursuant to the aforesaid order, NHAI has claimed forfeiture of ₹1,60,00,000/- towards part Performance Security and reserved its right to recover/adjust the amount against other ongoing contracts or the Common Bank Guarantee. The Company has challenged the said forfeiture by filing a Writ Petition before the appropriate Hon’ble Court.
